source_read: Chef & Brewer pub menus: every /pubs/<county>/<pub>/menu page in https://www.chefandbrewer.com/sitemap.xml (139) and the getmenus feed each page loads (https://www.chefandbrewer.com/api/menus/getmenus/<venue id>); 138 feeds read on 2026-10-11 (one pub, Butley Ash, answered 404: no online menu), combined sha256 9c50df7d6fc99301745d228de68a6def3c04722fd4efc7626827972b87819976; robots.txt of www.chefandbrewer.com disallows /sitecore/, /media/, /images/ and similar, not /pubs/ or /api/menus/
not_verifiable: the menus other than the Main Menu were not compared with a rendered page (the page's menu switcher did not open in the headless browser); they come from the same feed, in which every product prints the same calories at all 138 pubs
notes: Independent check: three pub menu pages (Green Man Inn, Brackley Hatch; Blundell Arms, Lancashire; George IV, Hertfordshire) rendered in headless Chromium as a visitor sees them; every displayed (dish name, 'NNN kcal') pair on their Main Menu (55 per pub, 165 in all) matched a published item's calories. Internal check: each product (by the feed's own product id) prints one calorie figure at every pub that lists it: 0 products differ between pubs, 0 printed at one pub only. Fixed in the script: two products sharing a name (vegetarian and vegan Falafel Burger, main and no-gluten puddings) had been merged by name (now told apart by product id); 'lamb rump' had been tagged beef from the word 'rump'; '... of the Day' dishes (they change daily) are left out. Left out: 41 alcoholic drinks (5,494 rows across the pubs; founder's rule of 11 Oct 2026), rows with no calories printed, 'of the day' dishes. Allergens: link only (Smart Chef, robots.txt Disallow: /).
